item.title: NASA Satellite Images Show Western U.S. ‘Snow Drought’
item.description: NASA says the current pace of snowfall (or lack thereof) has the region facing a "snow drought," a term that indicates a critically low snowpack

item.title: Asher Pacey Is Bleeding Style on a Twin Fin in ‘Ley Lines’
item.description: You've heard of Asher Pacey not because he screams his name online for views, but because he quietly goes about his business of surfing extraordinarily well.

item.title: 330-Pound Bull Shark Caught Near Site of Fatal Attack on Young Australian Boy
item.description: Australian fishermen captured a 330-pound bull shark near the site of last week's fatal shark attack in Sydney Harbor.

item.title: Julian Wilson on How Donald Trump Foiled His Championship Tour Comeback
item.description: Julian Wilson still surfs at a Championship Tour level. But he skipped most of the Challenger Series amidst his comeback. We spoke with him to find out why.

item.title: Lindsey Vonn Airlifted to Hospital After Crash During World Cup Race
item.description: Lindsey Vonn was airlifted to the hospital after crashing in her last downhill race before the Milano Cortina Winter Olympics. Her left knee was injured.

item.title: Netflix Profited Off the Possibility That Alex Honnold Could Die in ‘Skyscraper Live’
item.description: When Alex Honnold climbed Taipei 101 live on Netflix, it felt gross because Netflix was capitalizing on the possibility that he could fall to his death.

item.title: Team USA’s Oldest Athlete Is a 44-Year-Old Snowboarder Who Trains on a Backyard Track
item.description: Nick Baumgartner is Team USA's oldest athlete. And he trains on a handmade, backyard pumptrack for snowboard cross, turning pressure into pleasure.

item.title: Night Hiker Rescued After Trying to Reach Summit Using Phone Light
item.description: An under-equipped night hiker found himself in need of a rescue in Summit County, Colorado this week. After the light on his phone died, things got desperate.

item.title: David Meier, GoPro’s Newest Athlete, Drops His 5 Most Insane Clips from 2025
item.description: David Meier, GoPro's newest athlete, was a good pick up. He's not your average skier, but he is an interesting one. Here are his five best clips from 2025.

item.title: Jamie O’Brien Tells Story of Time Angry Partiers Kicked in Volcom House Gate
item.description: On the latest episode of his podcast with Mason Ho, Jamie O'Brien shared a story about the time a bunch of guests weren't quite ready to leave the Volcom house.
